name: Queen Cornelia
source:
Cornelia is the young queen who rules the kingdom of Panetelia. With outstanding political skills, she has led her kingdom to prosperity and is widely beloved by her people.

However, when Alice first speaks with Cornelia, she receives a harsh glare and cryptic words delivered in a condescending tone.

This event puzzles Alice greatly, yet there seems to be some deeper reason behind it...?
[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3562120/view/702124777298461817] Steam [/url]]
